subject.title: feat(onboarding): recommend plugins and skills from installed apps

question: Should installed-app names be sent to the configured model and ClawHub by default with disclosure and an opt-out, or must onboarding obtain explicit consent before any app inventory leaves the machine?
rationale: The PR explicitly makes default-on inventory egress a product choice, and repository policy cannot safely resolve that privacy and onboarding trust decision without maintainer intent.

options.title: Require consent first
options.body: Prompt before scanning or transmitting app identifiers, then continue only after explicit approval.

options.title: Approve disclosure-only default
options.body: Keep default-on matching, but explicitly accept the privacy tradeoff and require minimized payloads plus live proof.

options.title: Defer recommendations
options.body: Split and land only the independent inference fix while pausing the recommendation and remote-inventory surfaces.

recommendation.title: Require consent first
recommendation.body: Prompt before scanning or transmitting app identifiers, then continue only after explicit approval.

likelyOwner.reason: The setup wizard history and current assignment make steipete the strongest available owner for the onboarding consent policy.
